text_block_list.text:
One day, I visited an arcade with 
Maruzensky.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Look, look, look at thiiis! It's called 
VR, y'know~!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"When I said I wanted to try something 
trendy, my junior told me all about it!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"I heard you can experience flying over a 
planet at 40,000 km/h! Isn't that 
in-sane?!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
And on that note, I'll be taking my 
leave~♪

The moment Maruzensky climbed aboard the 
machine, the fan mounted in front began 
spinning with tremendous force...!!
(Whirrrrrrr......)

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Now then, which of the two will show me a 
better dream... her, or my Tacchan...?!
(SWOOSH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaaaaaa~~~h!?

"Blasting at ultra-high speed between the 
lush green earth and the mysterious sky—it 
took a sudden dive, and came to an abrupt 
halt!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You were really flying out there~~!! You 
were faster than the wind~!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Tac-chan is great and all, but that 
brand-new sense of speed... What an 
incredible rush...!
(SWOOSH!!)

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"I'm getting chills! It's 
super-duper-great~~~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Ha!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, I'm fine. No, actually, more than 
that, I—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I feel so refreshed! My mind is crystal 
clear!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe you just opened a new door at 
40,000 kilometers per hour?"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Just kidding, ufufuâª

From that day on, Maruzensky's running 
grew even more polished!
